# Brightwater Marine Logistics Ltd: Annual Summary FY2025

Brightwater Marine Logistics operates coastal container feeder services and harbor towage from its head office in Tauranga. This summary accompanies the full annual report and presents headline results for the financial year ended 30 June 2025.

## Chair's Overview

The year was defined by the delivery of new tugs and the renegotiation of the Northport feeder contract. Revenue grew in each year presented, while tighter fuel procurement lifted operating margin. The board thanks crews and shore staff for a year without a lost-time injury at sea.

## Financial Summary

All figures are in NZD thousands unless otherwise stated.

| Line item | FY2023 | FY2024 | FY2025 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 184,620 | 201,355[^1] | 219,870 |
| Cost of services | 131,040 | 143,615 | 154,290 |
| Gross profit | 53,580 | 57,740 | 65,580 |
| Operating expenses | 34,910 | 37,265 | 40,135 |
| Operating income | 18,670 | 20,475 | 25,445 |
| Net income | 12,385 | 13,960 | 17,215[^2] |
| Return on capital employed | 9.2%[^3] | 10.4% | 11.8% |
| Fleet vessels (count) | 27 | 29 | 33 |
| Employees (FTE) | 1,093 | 1,175 | 1,268 |

> **NOTE:** Employee figures are reported on a full-time-equivalent basis. Counted as individual people, Brightwater employed 1,412 staff at the end of FY2025, including part-time shore staff and relief crew.

## Operations

The fleet grew with the delivery of two harbor tugs and the charter of two feeder vessels. Average fleet utilisation was 82 percent, and on-time arrival at scheduled ports reached 91 percent. Fuel consumption per container moved fell by 4.6 percent following hull coating upgrades.

## Capital Allocation

Capital expenditure for FY2025 was directed mainly at fleet renewal. The board's target return on capital employed for FY2026 is 11.3 percent.

[^1]: FY2024 revenue restated to 198,140 following reclassification of fuel surcharge rebates. Other FY2024 lines are shown as originally reported.
[^2]: Includes a one-off gain of 1,870 on the sale of the vessel Kaimai Star.
[^3]: Restated to 8.7 percent after the impairment review.
